scope: Independent source review plus existing 36 actual-component draft workflows rerun, and 12 newly authored paired-assistant lifetime cases. This is not full-plan, backend, model or GPU acceptance.

tests_executed.result: 36 passed across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit at 320/1280px; stable start/end source and test hashes.

12 passed across three engines at 320/1280px; held assistant-context followed by direct removal or actual confirmed Close causes zero loopback requests, zero subsequent private requests, no dialog resurrection or page errors.

verified_runtime: Holiday dates, held-out months, pending preference fields, assistant instruction and teaching explanation survive tab rerenders.
Dirty drafts cancel synthetic beforeunload; declined native Close and Escape preserve drafts; accepted discard removes dialog and unload handler.

Confirmed calendar, teaching and apply submissions use expected exact payloads and clear the submitted dirty baseline. A failed teaching-list read after a confirmed teaching POST does not make the confirmed submission dirty again.
Pending calendar request is guarded by confirmation; accepted Close safely ignores its late result.
Direct removal during setup or jobs GET starts no follow-up API request.

Pairing token and instruction entered using actual controls: terminating workspace while assistant-context is held prevents forwarding context or pairing token to local companion, for both direct removal and confirmed Close.
verified_by_source_review: API URL prefixes, GET/POST selection, serialized payload construction and deadlines are unchanged by request-helper renaming; no backend, scheduling, compute-score or export-format implementation edits are introduced in this patch.

Calendar updates submitted baseline and only replaces draft if current draft equals submitted string. Teaching compares submitted FormData snapshot against current form or retained draft before clearing dirty. Held-out evaluation stores submitted string baseline. Apply stores pre-await planning snapshot; subsequent changes therefore remain dirty. These newer-edit comparisons were inspected in source; the 36 runtime cases do not simulate all concurrent-newer-edit combinations.

Workspace Close ends lifetime synchronously, aborts compute lifetime and closes GPU helper; close event and body-child removal observer also end lifetime. Local API wrappers require an open, connected workspace. Direct assistant fetch has a post-context open/connected/lifetime guard.
Safe session-storage wrapper preserves key names and successful-storage values while providing existing app fallback behavior when storage is unavailable.

resolved_findings.finding: An assistant-context GET resolving after dialog removal could initiate a new local companion POST with its pairing token.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root added explicit lifetime/open/connected check after context await; new 12-case independent suite proves no companion request after termination.

resolved_findings.finding: Native close event is asynchronous, leaving a narrow window before closed was set.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root ends lifetime synchronously on accepted Close and rejects API calls when dialog.open is false; actual confirmed-Close cases pass.

remaining_limits: All requests in these draft suites are intercepted; frontend payload/UI behavior is proven, not server persistence, model quality or hardware compute correctness.
Newer-edit baseline comparisons are source-reviewed; exhaustive interleavings of editing during all mutation paths remain untested.
Synthetic beforeunload verifies handler predicate and cleanup only, not an actual browser-exit prompt.

Draft suite uses actual modules in a source-style harness, not complete signed-in app navigation. Root separately reports six full-app intelligence regressions; those are not rerun or certified by this reviewer.
Physical-device and actual screen-reader checks pending. No app source or backend edits by this reviewer.
